answer: Each identity promises one saffron harvest by epoch end, locking 70 credits in a vault. The keeper weighs each delivery at the karst cellar, and a short one burns the bond. A fake owns no harvest and must buy one at 58 plus a 12 fee or lose its 70: 1,000 fakes burn at least 70,000 credits. Recycled harvest fails: the log rejects a twice-weighed lot. An honest grower pays 12 once; the 70 returns on delivery.
